translations.web: The nations will see and be ashamed of all their might. They will lay their hand on their mouth. Their ears will be deaf.
translations.bsb: Nations will see and be ashamed, deprived of all their might. They will put their hands over their mouths, and their ears will become deaf.
translations.kjv: The nations shall see and be confounded at all their might: they shall lay their hand upon their mouth, their ears shall be deaf.
translations.asv: The nations shall see and be ashamed of all their might; they shall lay their hand upon their mouth; their ears shall be deaf.
